cands.bio: Republican state representative for Alabama House District 44 (Jefferson County) since 2014. A CPA by training, he spent his career in finance, including as CFO of Birmingham Steel, North American Bus Industries, Progress Rail and Vulcan Steel Products. He served on the Trussville school board after a 2010 appointment.
cands.gaps: We found no documented statements or actions by Danny Garrett on data centers, homestead property taxes, limits on out-of-state or institutional land buyers, growth and land conservation, immigration or H-1B, police pay and pensions, or school choice and teacher pay. The only stated positions we could read are from his 2014 campaign (pro-life, Second Amendment, lower taxes, less spending and regulation). The list of bills he sponsored did not load on the page we read. He did not complete Ballotpedia's 2022 or 2026 candidate surveys. We found no controversies, foreign ties or notable endorsements in the pages available. His current leadership post is not confirmed by a current official source.

qual.background: Alabama House member since 2014, reported as House majority whip since 2018; co-chaired legislative task forces on budget reform and federal tax law. Former CPA at Ernst & Young and CFO of several manufacturing companies; appointed Trussville school board member in 2010.
qual.why: Over a decade of legislative service plus a long finance career as a CPA and CFO fits the work of writing law and the state budget. Committee chairmanships were not counted toward the score.
